5221:
[נָכָה] 501 _vb_. **smite** (not in **Qal**)
**Niph**. **and he shall be smitten** [struck by weapon in battle] **and die**
**Pu**. both **be smitten down** by the hail
**Hiph**.
**1.**
**a.** lit., **smite** (with a single, non-fatal, blow), **strike**
**b.** **smite** repeatedly, **beat** a man
**c.** **and they clapped hands** (in applause)
**d.** **give a thrust** (with fork) into pot; **strike** roots
**e.** rarely **smite** (in battle) so as (merely) to wound
**f.** **smite**, of sun
**2.** **Smite** fatally
**3.** **Smite** = **attack**, **attack and destroy** a company
**4.** Of God
**a.** **smite** with a plague, disease, etc.
**b.** **smite** = **chastise**, or **send judgment upon**
**c.** of God’s **destroying** palaces
**Hoph**. **be smitten**

5276: [נָעֵם] _vb_. **be pleasant**, **delightful**, **lovely**;—**Qal** Pf. 3 fs. נָעֵ֑מָה [[01-genesis.49.15|Gn 49:15]] (poem in J; of land); 2 ms. (of delightful friend) נָעַ֥מְתָּ לִי מְאֹד [[10-2-samuel.1.26|2 S 1:26]], also (of physical beauty) מִמִּי נָעָ֑מְתָּ [[26-ezekiel.32.19|Ez 32:19]]; 2 fs. (_id_.) וּמַה־נָּעַמְתְּ [[22-song-of-songs.7.7|Ct 7:7]] **how lovely art thou!**; 3 pl., of pleasant words, נָעֵ֑מוּ [[19-psalms.141.6|ψ 141:6]]; Impf. 3ms יִנְעָ֑ם: [[20-proverbs.2.10|Pr 2:10]] (of knowledge); [[20-proverbs.9.17|9:17]]; [[20-proverbs.24.25|24:25]] is impers. c. ל, **to them ... shall be delight**.
5278:
נֹ֫עַם _n.m_. [[19-psalms.90.17|ψ 90:17]] **delightfulness**, **pleasantness** (Ecclus נועם תירוש 32:6);—נ׳ abs. [[38-zechariah.11.7|Zc 11:7]] + 4 t.; cstr. [[19-psalms.27.4|ψ 27:4]] [[19-psalms.90.17|90:17]];—
**1.** **delightfulness** of י׳: contemplated in temple [[19-psalms.27.4|ψ 27:4]], shewn in his favour, וִיהִי נ׳ אדני ... עָלֵינוּ [[19-psalms.90.17|90:17]].
**2.** name of one of two symbol. staves [[38-zechariah.11.7|Zc 11:7]], [[38-zechariah.11.10|10]].
**3.** **pleasantness**, as defining genit.: דַרְכֵי־נ׳ [[20-proverbs.3.17|Pr 3:17]]; אִמְרֵי־נ׳ [[20-proverbs.15.26|15:26]] [[20-proverbs.16.24|16:24]].
